purpose: Local model selection and application integration verification; not research-paper accuracy or held-out validation.
changes: Actual indexed-file metadata answers inventory and exact-filename queries without language-model inference.
Whole numbered source records are packed within the context budget; this installation uses 12288.
The prompt maps source_number to numeric citations. Missing citations trigger at most one tool-free regeneration from fresh evidence, followed by the unchanged citation guard.
Invalid explicit citations or an unsuccessful retry return the original exact source excerpts.
Normal and demo workspaces share one local model service and retain separate databases.

manual_review.final_eight_answerable_responses: All requested facts were present and their numeric references pointed to supporting supplied excerpts; no contradictory project facts observed.
manual_review.unknowns: Both final synthetic unknown questions returned exactly Not in the documents.
manual_review.summary: Storage profile, 61-hour backup interval and 11 May 2028 review date were retained semantically. Literal scoring failed because name/date wording changed. The summary also included a generic data-integrity rationale not explicitly stated in the source.
limits: The final configuration changed the model, context and integration logic; differences are not a model-only quality estimate.

regression_tests.scope: Citation retry regression verification after production implementation was frozen
coverage: Successful uncited-to-cited regeneration with a single tool-free retry
Still-uncited, invalid-reference, empty, tool-call, OllamaUnavailable and ValueError retry failures
No retry for valid references, invalid original numeric references, accepted unknown abstention, no evidence or genuine conversation recall
Full original source-pool repacking with larger retry excerpts under an 8192-context stress fixture
Successful answer cards match the actual fitted retry payload
Failed retry cards and quoted excerpts remain the original safe evidence
No draft, assistant envelope, tool-result envelope or tool schemas in the retry payload
Single retry maximum and both normal and forced-final synthesis paths
